chunks: As for whatever is in it from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from his brother al-Hasan, from Zur'ah ibn Muhammad al-Hadrami, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; an immediate transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author's direct statement of transmission
key_terms.زُرْعَةَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ: the named narrator Zur'ah ibn Muhammad al-Hadrami in the transmission chain
key_terms.سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ: the named narrator Sama'ah ibn Mihran, the final transmitter mentioned here

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for Zur'ah from Sama'ah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Zur'ah from Sama'ah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the precise line of transmission for hadith verification and hadith sciences.
